with_search.bear_case_summary: NVIDIA's valuation is heavily distorted by a speculative narrative, evidenced by a market EV/EBITDA of 39.4x, representing a massive 479% premium over its mathematically justified multiple of 6.8x. While the reverse DCF implies a 31.6% revenue CAGR (below the 50% historical rate), the multiple disconnect exposes extreme vulnerability to margin compression. The most credible threat is outlined in the 'Hyperscaler ASIC Substitution' scenario (proposed by value_chain), where major cloud providers shift AI workloads to custom silicon, reducing reliance on merchant GPUs. This scenario drops the Intrinsic Price per Share (IPS) to $176.92, an 18.2% downside. Furthermore, the absolute bear case DCF models a catastrophic collapse to $0 per share (-100% downside). Even if cyclical normalization occurs, as seen in the 'AI Capex Normalization' scenario, the sheer weight of the 479% multiple premium means any fundamental disappointment or successful ASIC substitution will trigger a severe valuation rerating.

no_search.bear_case_summary: The current valuation of NVDA is driven by extreme speculative fervor, evidenced by a market EV/EBITDA of 39.4x compared to a mathematically justified multiple of just 6.8x—a staggering 479% premium. While the reverse DCF implies a 10-year revenue CAGR of 31.6% (below the 50% historical rate), the absolute valuation leaves zero margin of safety, with the absolute bear case DCF pointing to a total wipeout at $0/share. The agent-proposed 'Hyperscaler ASIC Substitution' scenario (proposed by value_chain) exposes a critical structural vulnerability: if major cloud providers successfully transition AI workloads to custom silicon, reliance on merchant GPUs will plummet, compressing terminal margins and dragging the Intrinsic Price per Share (IPS) down to $176.92 (-18.2% downside). Furthermore, the 'AI Capex Normalization' scenario (proposed by context) warns that the current generative AI infrastructure build-out represents a cyclical peak. If the massive 479% multiple premium collapses to its mathematically justified baseline, investors face catastrophic downside risk that is currently masked by AI euphoria.
